description_en: Ends the wait state of a scaling activity in advance to execute the next action if a lifecycle hook is configured for a scaling group
description_zh: 如果您为伸缩组配置了生命周期挂钩功能，您可以根据实际业务需要，调用API CompleteLifecycleAction提前结束伸缩活动的等待状态去执行下一步动作
kebab_example: aliyun ess complete-lifecycle-action --lifecycle-hook-id ash-bp14g3ee6bt3sc980000 --lifecycle-action-token aaaa-bbbbb-cccc-ddddd --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CompleteLifecycleAction

parameters.help_en: The ID of the lifecycle hook
parameters.name: lifecycle_hook_id

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the wait state for the scaling activity. You can obtain this value from the Message Service (MNS) queue or MNS topic specified by the lifecycle hook
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩活动的等待状态标识符，您可以从生命周期挂钩指定的MNS队列或MNS主题中获取该值
parameters.name: lifecycle_action_token

parameters.help_en:
The next action to perform after the wait state of the lifecycle hook ends. Valid values:
CONTINUE: Continues the scale-out activity and adds the ECS instance to the scaling group, or continues the scale-in activity and removes the ECS instance from the scaling group.
ABANDON: Terminates the scale-out activity and releases the created ECS instance, or continues the scale-in activity and removes the ECS instance from the scaling group.
ROLLBACK: Rejects the release of the ECS instance and performs a rollback for a scale-in activity. For a scale-out activity, the effect is the same as ABANDON.

If you do not specify this parameter, the next action after the wait state of the lifecycle hook ends remains the `DefaultResult` value configured for the lifecycle hook.

If multiple lifecycle hooks exist in the scaling group and are triggered simultaneously, the final next action is determined as follows:
For a scale-in activity, when the wait state triggered by an ABANDON or ROLLBACK lifecycle hook ends, the wait states of subsequent lifecycle hooks are ended in advance.
If the lifecycle hook that suspends the scale-in activity is of the CONTINUE type, or for a scale-out activity, subsequent lifecycle hooks continue to suspend the scaling activity until the wait state triggered by the last lifecycle hook ends. The final next action is determined by the type of the last lifecycle hook that ends the wait state
parameters.help_zh:
生命周期挂钩等待状态结束后的下一步动作。取值范围：
CONTINUE：继续响应弹性扩张活动，将ECS实例添加至伸缩组；继续响应弹性收缩活动，将ECS实例从伸缩组移除。
ABANDON：终止弹性扩张活动，直接释放创建出来的ECS实例；继续响应弹性收缩活动，将ECS实例从伸缩组移除。
ROLLBACK：针对弹性收缩活动，会拒绝释放ECS实例，进行回滚；针对弹性扩张活动，效果同ABANDON一样。

如您不指定该参数，生命周期挂钩等待状态结束后的下一步动作则仍然保持为生命周期挂钩设置的`DefaultResult`值。

伸缩组中存在多个生命周期挂钩时同步触发，最终的下一步动作如下：
对弹性收缩活动，在ABANDON或ROLLBACK类型生命周期挂钩触发的等待状态结束时，会将提前结束后续生命周期挂钩的等待状态。
在挂起弹性收缩活动的生命周期挂钩类型为CONTINUE时，或者对弹性扩张活动，后续生命周期挂钩会继续挂起伸缩活动，直到最后一个生命周期挂钩触发的等待状态结束。最终的下一步动作以最后一个结束等待状态的生命周期挂钩类型为准
parameters.name: lifecycle_action_result

parameters.help_en:
Ensures the idempotence of the request.

You can generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
